consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM asks 'does crafting_inventory() hold >=20 scrap?' to decide if the salvage objective is satisfied.
scope: items reachable nearby (the avatar's carried items plus the surrounding crafting-reach tiles), as spanned by crafting_inventory() -- not on-person carried items only.
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) -- builds u.crafting_inventory() and returns tmp_inv.has_amount(item_id, item_count), yielding the engine's own completion predicate.
divergence: Avatar carries 12 scrap with 10 more scrap on an adjacent reachable tile: total 22>=20 so the engine predicate returns complete, but a carried-only re-derivation returns 12<20 and wrongly reports incomplete.
